# v0.8.9 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the isolated `moddotplot-interactive-0.8.9-source` copy. The sibling
v0.8.8 source remains available for comparison and rollback. No deployment, upload,
tag, or remote publication is part of this local source-copy release.

## Release acceptance focus

Final integrated validation established all of the following:

* package, Rust workspace, generated Wasm package, citation, provenance, and CycloneDX
  metadata consistently identify v0.8.9;
* the bundled example requests `Col-CEN_v1.2.fasta`,
  `Col-CEN_v1.2.fasta.fai`, and `ColCEN_CEN180.gff3` and reports monotonic percentage
  progress through completion, using the download label from 0–95% and the indexed
  preparation label from 95–100%;
* the bundled FAI is passed to the indexed-input path and makes every indexed
  chromosome selectable without eager packing of the full FASTA;
* cancellation, network failure, or invalid example assets leave no stale or partial
  session;
* one multi-sequence GFF3/GTF logical track, or one same-named BED track, produces
  exactly one sidebar row rather than one row per chromosome;
* that logical row automatically displays the records matching each selected X or
  Y chromosome and does not show records from a different identifier;
* visibility, row count, ordering, and deletion operate on the logical row without
  chromosome-specific duplicates; and
* the complete unit, production-build, documentation, and supported-browser regression
  suites pass on the final integrated source.

## Verification status

The final integrated release run was completed on 2026-09-30.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Rust formatting and linting | Passed: `cargo fmt --all --check` was clean and strict all-target/all-feature Clippy passed with warnings denied |
| Rust tests | Passed: 81 tests passed with 5 intentional benchmark/diagnostic ignores under `cargo test --workspace --all-features` |
| TypeScript unit tests | Passed: 28 Vitest files completed with 144 tests passed and 1 intentional scale-only skip |
| Production UI build | Passed: 28 modules built; optimized Wasm is 246.10 kB, 90.42 kB gzip; the production directory contains the FASTA, FAI, and GFF3 assets |
| Supported-browser suite | Passed: 99 Playwright cases completed across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with 95 passed and 4 expected platform-specific skips |
| v0.8.9 feature browser matrix | Passed: 9/9 indexed-example progress and unified-annotation cases across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit |
| Manual local preview | Passed on port 4179 with the real bundled assets: download progress was visible, all 7 FAI records appeared, CEN180 produced one 5-sequence row, and switching Chr1 to Chr2 retained that row with the matching panels |
| Rust workspace metadata | Passed: both local crates resolve as v0.8.9 with `cargo metadata --no-deps` |
| JSON release metadata | Passed: package, lockfile, generated Wasm package, and regenerated CycloneDX documents parse and identify v0.8.9 |
| Documentation contract | Passed: 74 generated Markdown documents, local links, and current implementation contracts checked |

The manual preview used the production v0.8.9 site rather than a mocked fixture. The
landing page exposed a determinate progress bar during the 134 MB example download
(observed at 35% in flight), then entered the indexed workspace with Chr1–Chr5, ChrM,
and ChrC available. `ColCEN_CEN180` appeared once with the summary `5 matching
sequences · GFF3 · 66,131 displayed features`; changing the self plot from Chr1 to
Chr2 kept one logical control and selected the appropriate X and Y track data.
